headline: Contested Fronts Renew Activity Across the Ledger
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the campaign has found fresh motion in several contested sectors. Weathered Expanse is again the busiest immediate front, recording seven base events in two hours and 61 over the day; its ledger now shows five Colonial, no Warden, and four neutral holdings. Kuura Strand has surged sharply, with 15 events in the latest two hours and 19 over 24 hours, amid accelerating casualty and enlistment rates; five bases remain Warden-held and one Colonial. Nevish Line has also produced five recent events, while Fisherman’s Row has posted two, with both maps retaining divided ownership. Stlican Shelf has slowed from its earlier burst to one event in two hours and 20 across the day, standing at seven Colonial and two Warden bases. Callahan’s Passage, formerly a furnace of movement, is quiet in the latest windows despite 20 daily events and all ten bases Warden-held. Palantine Berm retains the largest daily event tally among the quiet fronts, but no fresh movement appears in two hours. The next day’s most useful signals lie in these divided or recently active ledgers.
